title: 17 简单点杀人的方式简单点1218 完成心愿22
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 白色的雪安静地落着，纯白的世界总让人心生安宁，那是一种死亡的安宁，似是老天爷在提醒你“死去万事皆空，忙碌不如休息”。
丫丫小手冻得冰凉，却咬着牙，垂着脸，双眼泛红地盯着那在泪水里越发模糊的旋风团花儿，口中念念有词：“年关要到了，丫丫要绣好看的花花，要赚钱...”
滴答。
泪水终于落了下来，落在了手背。
一瞬间的温暖，很快被寒风吹冷。
屋中因穷未生炭火。
丫丫的手已经冻僵的就连针扎进去都感觉不到痛楚了。
而院儿方向却依然很吵。
吵得这位六岁的小丫头心惊肉跳。
她侧过小脑袋，明明看不到，却还是看向院儿方向。
院儿里...
孟小娘子正手拿槌衣棒指着对面的华衣中年人，那是张管家。
张管家笑眯眯道：“孟娘子，你男人得了疯煞，不知跑哪儿去了，走前还带走了不少钱吧？
你去报官找人，城中老爷怎么回你的？
每年因煞而死的人也不是一个两个，老爷让你等，只是让你多等几日好直接结案。
到时候啊，档案上就是因煞死亡。
啧啧啧，他一走，你这孤儿寡母的又怎得生活下去？
你呀，怎么还不明白？跟了我，这才是你最好的选择。
来来来，快把衣槌放下。”
他笑着的眼睛很贼，贼兮兮地小娘子丰腴的身体上打转，哪怕隔着衣袄，那种青春靓丽带来的肉体吸引力却依然强大。
越是包得紧张，张管家就越想看看那解带宽衣后的美景。
他看着眼前倔强到甚至有几分贞烈感的小娘子，心中越发躁动。
英雄好烈马。
这种老色鬼，也喜烈妇。
因为当他征服烈妇的时候，不仅享受了胴体，也享受了压下对方精神的快感。
然而...
孟小娘子只吐出了一个字。
张管家也不生气，只是呵呵笑着，道：“你说说你，生的这么骚，就算你不跟着我，那半夜三更遭个歹徒糟蹋了，那不也是正常？”
他环顾左右，道：“这小巷子挺偏，你家里还有个六岁的小丫头吧？”
孟小娘子愣了下，脸色发白。
这种云淡风轻的威胁，她岂会听不明白？
张管家一拂袖，负于身后，转身走出了这小院儿，走了几步，见到不远处有坊间邻人，他淡笑一下，嘀咕道：“这孟小娘子怎么回事？明明才没了丈夫，就迫不及待地勾引我。哼！我张某人要不是同情她家境遇，真是半点都不想来！”
一时间，邻里指指点点。
风里飘来“骚妇”、“淫妇”、“不知礼义廉耻”之类的声音...
content_en:
The white snow falls quietly, and the pure white world always makes people feel at peace. It is a kind of peace of death, as if God is reminding you that "everything is useless after death, and it is better to rest than to be busy."
Yaya's little hands were cold from the cold, but she gritted her teeth, lowered her face, and stared at the whirlwind flowers that were getting blurry in her tears with red eyes. She muttered something: "The new year is coming, Yaya wants to embroider beautiful flowers and make money..."
Tick tock.
The tears finally fell and fell on the back of my hands.
The warmth for a moment was quickly blown away by the cold wind.
There was no charcoal fire in the house because of poverty.
Yaya's hands were so frozen that she couldn't even feel the pain when the needle was inserted.
But the direction of the courtyard is still very noisy.
The noise made the six-year-old girl feel frightened.
She turned her little head, even though she couldn't see it, she still looked in the direction of the courtyard.
In the courtyard...
Mrs. Meng was pointing the mallet stick at the middle-aged man in Chinese clothes across from her. That was Butler Zhang.
Butler Zhang smiled and said: "Ms. Meng, your man is crazy and has gone somewhere. Did he take a lot of money with him before leaving?
If you go to report to the official to find someone, how will the master in the city respond to you?
Not just one or two people die every year due to evil spirits. The master asked you to wait. He just asked you to wait a few more days so that the case can be concluded directly.
When the time comes, it will be recorded as death due to evil spirits.
Tsk tsk tsk, once he leaves, how can you, an orphan and a widower, survive?
You, why don’t you understand? Follow me, this is your best choice.
Come on, come on, put the hammer down quickly. "
His smiling eyes were very naughty, and the naughty eyes were dancing on the little lady's plump body. Even through the clothes, the physical attraction brought by youthful beauty was still strong.
The more nervous she was, the more Butler Zhang wanted to see the beautiful scenery after taking off her clothes.
He looked at the young lady in front of him who was so stubborn that she even had a sense of chastity, and his heart became more and more restless.
The hero is very strong.
This kind of old pervert also likes fierce women.
Because when he conquered the fierce woman, he not only enjoyed the body, but also enjoyed the pleasure of suppressing the other person's spirit.
However...
"Get out!"
Mrs. Meng only uttered one word.
Butler Zhang wasn't angry either. He just laughed and said, "Tell me about you. You are so naughty. Even if you don't follow me, you will be raped by a gangster in the middle of the night. Isn't that normal?"
He looked around and said, "This alley is quite remote. Do you have a six-year-old girl at home?"
Mrs. Meng was stunned for a moment and her face turned pale.
How could she not understand such a gentle threat?
Butler Zhang flicked his sleeves and walked out of the small courtyard. After walking a few steps, he saw a neighbor not far away. He smiled lightly and muttered: "What's going on with Miss Meng? She just lost her husband, and yet she couldn't wait to seduce me. Huh! If I, Mr. Zhang, didn't sympathize with her family's situation, I really wouldn't want to come at all!"
For a moment, the neighbors pointed fingers.
Voices such as "slut", "whore" and "ignorant of etiquette, justice and shame" floated in the wind...
